prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background artwork for JourneyPilot, an expressive contemporary travel-planning homepage. Generate ONLY a continuous landscape artwork, never a website mockup or a poster layout. Art direction: exquisite cinematic photographic realism blended with deliberate fine-art color grading, tangible atmospheric depth and richly detailed natural surfaces, composed like a contemporary travel magazine cover without any typography. Strong visual character and monumental scale, sophisticated and adventurous, not a generic stock travel advertisement and not a flat vector illustration. Deep forest green (#102c25) shadows, warm mineral and sun-yellow highlights, restrained natural local colors; avoid neon oversaturation. Landscape 16:9 composition. The leftmost 40 percent must be very dark, quiet, low-detail forest-green atmospheric negative space for separate live white headings and a cream input panel; DO NOT draw any text or panels there. The main recognizable subject sits in the rightmost 45 percent, from x=55 to 95 percent, with strong middle-distance forms and a compelling upper-right focal point. Let the setting flow naturally through the whole frame, not a hard split-screen. The central-right 50-80 percent must also work as a portrait crop. Finest print-quality details, authentic natural light and clear layered silhouettes, generous scale, no busy tourist collage. No people, lettering, logos, watermarks, markers, maps, routes, interface elements, frames, border, travel tickets, typography, geometric orbit rings, artificial grain overlay, or sticker graphics. This is original evocative travel artwork, not documentary proof of a particular landmark. Produce a polished final artwork.

Subject: an evocative southwest China mountain-and-river cityscape at blue hour, inspired by Sichuan and Chongqing, without inventing a named landmark. Monumental hazy mountain silhouettes and a broad river; on the right bank, a tightly composed stepped cluster of textured old town architecture, dark tiled roofs and warm amber window light, a small tea terrace partly framed by deep green broadleaf foliage. Natural real architectural proportions, no futuristic skyscrapers. Rich emerald shadows, warm vermilion accents and a very quiet blue-green river. Place all architectural detail in the rightmost 45 percent, with mountains receding to upper right; left 40 percent is dark water and mist with low contrast and almost no detail. Moody cinematic atmosphere, fine surface craft and a strong sense of place, calm without losing visual power. No people, text, signs, flags, paper lanterns, digital neon, fantasy architecture or route lines.
